trigger: A husk at your truck in the fallout rain (talk-down possible).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A man at your truck, shirtless in the grey rain. Burned-looking skin. Trying to open the door with his elbow.

nodes.speaker: husk
nodes.text: Warm. It's warm in there. I saw the light. My wife's in the car. She's cold. She's so cold.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Ears back. A soft, worried whine. She noses his hand. His breath smokes. Sick, not wrong.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Radiation sickness. Hypothermia. He's taken off his coat because his brain is lying to him about the cold.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You put the blanket on his shoulders. He weeps. He takes the pills like a child. He follows you inside.

nodes.speaker: husk
nodes.text: ...Pete. I'm Pete. Pete Lund. I left Galena to find my wife. I couldn't find her.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He's not strong. That's the worst part. He's not strong at all.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Wraith growls at the dark beyond him. Not at him. Something's been following him.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He wanders off into the grey. Behind him, from the end of the street, something tall starts to follow.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Husks draw them. You're sure of it now. Where the sick go, the tall ones follow.
